operations.name: get_messages
operations.result_evidence: Returns message records stored for one contact ID

operations.name: search_messages
operations.result_evidence: Returns locally stored message records matching a keyword

operations.name: send_message
operations.result_evidence: Creates a sent-message record; success does not prove remote delivery or reading

operations.name: delete_message
operations.result_evidence: Success confirms only that the matching local record was removed
